32086.name: Computer Science (BS)

groups.label: Composition and writing
groups.rule: Take both. WRIT 340 for engineers is strongly recommended.

groups.label: Mathematics
groups.rule: Take MATH 125, then one from each pair: MATH 126 or 129, MATH 225 or 235, MATH 226 or 229.

courses.title: Calculus II for Engineers and Scientists
Linear Algebra and Linear Differential Equations
Calculus III for Engineers and Scientists
Probability and Statistics for Engineers and Computer Scientists
General Biology: Organismal Biology and Evolution
Advanced General Biology: Organismal Biology and Evolution
General Biology: Cell Biology and Physiology
Fundamentals of Physics I: Mechanics, Oscillations and Waves

groups.label: Computer science core
groups.rule: Take all twelve. CSCI 102L, 103, 104, 170 and 201 need a C or better.

courses.title: Introduction to Algorithms and Theory of Computing
Capstone: Design and Construction of Large Software Systems

notes: Also take at least four 300- or 400-level CSCI courses (16 units), 20 units of general education and 4 units of free electives.

31776.name: Economics (BA)

groups.label: Economics core
groups.rule: Take all six. ECON 303, 305, 317 and 318 need a C or better.

groups.label: Mathematics
groups.rule: Take one, ideally by the end of sophomore year.

notes: Also take four economics electives at the 300 level or above. At least two must be 400 level or higher, and the other two need approval from the director of undergraduate studies.

31586.name: Arts, Technology and the Business of Innovation (BS)

groups.label: Challenge Based Reflective Learning
groups.rule: Take all of these. ACAD 174 is taken twice, and ACAD 376 can be replaced by credit-bearing internships.

courses.title: Industry Practicum I: Designing and Implementing Real-World Solutions

groups.label: Business
groups.rule: Take ACAD 183, plus ACAD 184 or ACAD 185.

courses.title: Operations Management and Finance for Challenge-Based Innova
Analytics and Marketing for Challenge-Based Innovation

groups.label: Design
groups.rule: Take ACAD 176 and 8 units from one path. Path 1 is ACAD 324 or 325, plus ACAD 360. Path 2 is the product design courses.

courses.title: The Practice of Design: Ideation to Innovation
Human Technology Interaction and the User Experience
Design Strategy: Problem Solving for Organizations

groups.label: Technology
groups.rule: Take ACAD 274 and 12 units from one tech path. Shown here: the Transformative AI and Full Stack Web Development paths.

courses.title: Introduction to Data Innovation and Analytics
Dev III: Designing Applications for Emerging Platforms

groups.label: Writing
groups.rule: Both appear in the sample four-year program.

notes: Also complete 36 units of major electives (no more than 20 outside the Academy) and the general education program. Other tech paths are physical and embedded computing and extended reality; see the catalogue.
